privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.preview_link: Preview how others see the profile

hide_dialog.title: Hide the profile from matches and search?
hide_dialog.text: You will receive no new interests unless you send one first.

everyone.label: Everyone
everyone.help: Your profile appears in matches and search for all members.

preference_match.label: Only people who fit my must-haves
preference_match.help: Only members who meet every preference you marked as a must-have can find or open your profile.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.help: Nobody can find you. Only people you send an interest to, and your connections, can open your profile.

interest_permission.title: Who can send me an interest

everyone.label: Anyone
everyone.help: Any member can send you an interest.

verified_only.label: Verified members only
verified_only.help: Only members with a verified photo or verified ID can send you an interest.

preference_match.label: Only people who fit my must-haves
preference_match.help: Only members who meet every preference you marked as a must-have can send you an interest.

name_display.title: Name shown to members
name_display.note: Your connections always see your full name.

photo_visibility.title: Who can see my photos
photo_visibility.note: No app can fully stop someone from photographing their screen. Share clear photos only with people you trust.

members.label: All members
members.help: Every member who can open your profile sees your photos.

interests_and_connections.label: People I show interest in
interests_and_connections.help: Photos are blurred. They become clear for people you send an interest to and for your connections.

connections.label: Connections only
connections.help: Photos are blurred until you and the other person are connected.

approved_only.label: Only people I approve
approved_only.help: Photos are blurred for everyone. You approve each person who may see them, including connections.

allow_photo_requests.title: Let members ask to see my photos
allow_photo_requests.help: When your photos are blurred, members can send you a request. You decide each one.

caste_visibility.title: Caste and sub-caste
caste_visibility.help: If you hide this from members, people who search or match by caste will not find you through it.

income_visibility.title: Income
income_visibility.help: If you hide this from members, it is not used to match you with people who ask for a minimum income.

family_visibility.title: Family details
family_visibility.help: Parents, siblings, family type and values, and your 'about my family' text. If hidden from members, family values are not used in matching.

career_details_visibility.title: Job title, employer and institute
career_details_visibility.help: Your education level and profession category are always visible.

home_visibility.title: Home details
home_visibility.help: Ownership, type and size of the family home.

area_visibility.title: Neighbourhood
area_visibility.help: Your city is always visible. This controls the area within the city.

show_last_active.title: Show when I was last active
show_last_active.help: If you turn this off, you also will not see when others were last active. Search can still order members by recent activity.

show_online_status.title: Show when I am online
show_online_status.help: If you turn this off, you also will not see who is online.

record_my_visits.title: Let members see that I viewed their profile
record_my_visits.help: If you turn this off you browse privately, your earlier visits are hidden too, and you cannot see who viewed your profile.

send_read_receipts.title: Read receipts
send_read_receipts.help: If you turn this off, others will not see when you have read their messages or opened their interest, and you will not see it for theirs.

privacy.details_note: Age, height, marital status, religion, sect, mother tongue, city, education level and profession are always visible to members who can open your profile. To hide the whole profile, change 'Profile visibility' or pause the profile.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: These switches only control push notifications and emails. Everything still appears in the app.

push.title: Push notifications
push.web_note: Push notifications are available in the Android app.

email.title: Email
email.note: Messages about your account and safety are always sent.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.help: No push notifications are sent between these times. They arrive when the quiet hours end, and they are always in the app.

blocked.title: Blocked members
blocked.text: Blocked members cannot see you, and you cannot see them.

unblock_dialog.title: Unblock {{name}}?
unblock_dialog.text: You will be able to see each other again. A connection or chat that ended is not restored.

sign_in.title: Sign-in and security
sign_in.unavailable: Sign-in and security settings are not available in this preview.

line.not_live: The profile is not live yet.

pause.title: Pause the profile?
pause.body: While it is paused: members cannot find the profile or send new interests. Interests you have already received stay open and you can still answer them. You can still chat with your connections. You cannot browse matches or send interests. You can resume at any time.

close.title: Close the profile?
close.body: Closing hides the profile from everyone except your connections. All open interests, sent and received, are closed. You can read your chats but cannot send messages. You can reopen the profile later.
close.mubarak: Mubarak! If the match is one of your connections, you can mark the engagement or nikah on that connection.

reopen.title: Reopen the profile?
reopen.body: The profile becomes visible to members again.
reopen.nikah_body: This profile was closed after a nikah was confirmed with {{name}}. Reopening ends that connection. Type REOPEN to confirm.

data.title: Your data
data.none: Get a copy of everything stored about you as a file.
data.queued: Your file is being prepared. This can take a few minutes. We will email you when it is ready.
data.failed: The file could not be prepared.
data.limit: You can request your data once every 24 hours.

gentle.title: Take a break instead?
gentle.text: Looking for a break instead? You can pause or close your profile and come back any time.

confirm.title: Delete your account?
confirm.list_label: What happens when you delete your account
confirm.hidden: Your profile is hidden from everyone as soon as you confirm.
confirm.days: You have {{days}} days to change your mind. Sign in again and choose "Keep my account".
confirm.purge: On {{date}} we permanently delete your profile, photos, preferences, contact details, identity number and verification images.
confirm.messages: Messages you sent are removed. People you chatted with will see "Member no longer available" and "Message removed".
confirm.record: We keep a minimal record for up to 2 years to protect other members: reports and moderation decisions about the account, and the dates you accepted our terms. If the account was banned, a scrambled fingerprint of the identity number, email and phone stays on a block list. It cannot be turned back into the original.
confirm.break: Looking for a break instead? You can pause your profile and come back any time.
